stem.en: An atom has 17 electrons. Which is its valence shell, and how many valence electrons does it have?

explanation.en: K takes 2 and L takes 8, which makes 10, so the other 7 go into M. The configuration is 2,8,7, which is chlorine. Option b puts everything after K into L, but L holds only 8. Option c assumes an outer shell is always full, but the count of 17 leaves only 7 for M.

hints.en: Fill K with 2 and L with 8. How many of the 17 electrons are left?
